metadata.name: Anm2Ed (Animation Editor)
metadata.description:
[h1]NOTE: THIS IS NOT A MOD! SUBSCRIBING TO THIS ISN'T NECESSARY (though it's appreciated)! It's recommended you head to the download page below![/h1]
[h2]Anm2Ed[/h2]
Anm2Ed is a modern editor for [i]The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth[/i]'s XML-based ".anm2" animation format. It is built as an extended, more comfortable replacement for the original proprietary animation editor, with a dockable Dear ImGui interface and tools aimed at both quick edits and larger animation workflows.
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*] Full ".anm2" editing: spritesheets (PNG or SVG), regions, layers, nulls, events, sounds, shaders, animations, frames and triggers (several events each). [*] Animation layers: a layer can play another animation, from the same file or a linked library (".anm2"), with per-keyframe loop/once/hold, start frame and restart. The timeline shows the child's tracks under the layer; double-click to edit the child in place, with a breadcrumb back out. [*] Dockable [url=https://github.com/ocornut/imgui]Dear ImGui[/url] interface (windows can be detached into their own) with persistent layout, drag and drop, context menus and rebindable shortcuts. [*] Timeline: multi-select, cut/copy/paste (whole frames or single properties), duplicate, split, bake, drag to move/resize, and start/end markers to loop a range. [*] Groups for animations, layers and nulls, with group transforms baked for the game on save. [*] Frame properties for crop, size, position, pivot, scale, skew, rotation, depth, tint, color offset (with alpha), blur (Flash's blur filter), region, shader, visibility, interpolation (including easing) and flips; batch changes across selections. [*] Spritesheet editor with pan, move, crop, draw, erase and color picker tools; regions; packing, merging, trimming; spritesheets and libraries reload when their files change on disk. [*] Animation preview with grid, axes, pivots, borders, onionskin (with pivot paths), and another document's animation as an overlay. [*] Wizards: generate animations from a grid, generate regions, change all frame properties, merge animations and files. [*] Render to video, GIF, spritesheet or PNG sequence (FFmpeg), with trigger sounds. [*] Each document targets Rebirth or the extended format. Rebirth saves write the game's format with the editor's own copy embedded ("SourceDocument"), so nothing is lost; animation layers are flattened for the game, and anything else the game doesn't support is warned about first. Extended saves write the editor's document alone. [*] Undo/redo, autosave (spritesheet edits included) with crash restore, and overwrite warnings. [/list]
[h3]Supported Languages[/h3] [list] [*] English [*] Español (Latinoamérica) (Spanish (Latin America)) [*] Pусский (Russian) [*] 中文 (Chinese) [*] 한국어 (Korean) [/list]
[b]If you want to help localize for your language, feel free to get in touch to contribute.[/b]
[h3]Rendering Animations[/h3] FFmpeg is required for video/GIF-style export. Download it from [url=https://ffmpeg.org/download.html]ffmpeg.org[/url], then point Anm2Ed to the ffmpeg executable in the render window.
[h2]Download (Windows)[/h2] https://github.com/ShweetsStuff/anm2ed/releases
Alternatively, if you have subscribed to the mod, you can find the latest release inside the "resources" folder. Once downloaded, you can put it wherever you want.
[h3]Happy animating![/h3] [img]https://files.catbox.moe/4auc1c.gif[/img]
